name: Orisha, Shango
body:
SHANGO
CR 21

A towering, dark, bare-chested muscular man stands before you, ax double-headed ax raised in challenge. Both his eyes and his weapon crackle with lightning as he challenges you.

XP 409,600
Unique LG Large outsider (air, good, lawful, orisha)
Init +5; Senses darkvision 60 ft., mistsight; Perception +42

DEFENSE

AC 37, touch 9, flat-footed 27 (+10 Dex, +18 natural, -1 size)
hp 402 (35d10+210)
Fort +18, Ref +28, Will +24
Defensive Abilities acid 10, fire 10, Immune charms, compulsions, electricity, fear, sonic
DR 10/epic and evil; SR 32

OFFENSE

Speed 50 ft.
Melee +5 double-bladed oxê +52/+47/+42/+37 (2d12+12/19-20/x3 plus 2d8 electricity and 2d8 sonic and trip); +5 thunder oxê +50/+45/+40/+35 (1d12+12/19-20/x3 plus 2d8 sonic) and +5 lightning oxê +50/+45/+40 (1d12+12/19-20/x3 plus 2d8 electricity)
Ranged rock +45 (2d8+18)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks breath weapon (30-foot cone, 10d8 fire and 5d8 acid damage, Reflex DC 33 half), rock throwing (120 ft.), split the blades, thunderous strike, thundering stone, thunderous leap

STATISTICS

Str 35, Dex 30, Con 22, Int 18, Wis 19, Cha 23
Base Atk +35; CMB +48; CMD +58
Feats Blinding Critical, Cleave, Critical Focus, Double Slice, Furious Focus, Great Cleave, Greater Two-Weapon Fighting, Greater Vital Strike, Improved Critical (oxê), Improved Two-Weapon Fighting, Improved Vital Strike, Lunge, Power Attack, Staggering Critical, Stunning Critical, Two-Weapon Fighting, Two-Weapon Rend, Vital Strike
Skills Acrobatics +30 (+50 to jump), Bluff +30, Diplomacy +30, Intimidate +30, Knowledge (history) +30, Knowledge (nature) +30, Knowledge (nobility) +30, Knowledge (planes) +30, Knowledge (religion) +30, Perception +42, Sense Motive +42, Spellcraft +30, Stealth +30, Survival +30; Racial Modifiers +12 Acrobatics (to jump)
Languages Aquan, Auran, Celestial, Common, Sylvan, Treant
SQ charged stones

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Air-Walker (Su)

Shango can walk on air at will as if using air walk, but the effect cannot be dispelled. When he is walking at least 30 feet above the ground, he also gains freedom of movement.

Breath of Fire and Smoke (Su)

Once every 1d4 rounds, Shango can breathe smoke and fire from his nostrils, dealing 10d8 point of fire damage and 5d8 points of acid damage (DC 33 Reflex half). In addition, the smoke lingers for 1d6 rounds, providing concealment within 5 feet and total concealment farther than 5 feet away. The hot, acrid smoke also deals 1d6 points of fire damage and 1d6 points of acid damage to creatures entering it or beginning their turn within it (no save). The save DC is Constitution-based.

Charged Stones (Su)

When Shango uses his thundering stone ability, roll 1d6-2 (minimum 0). The result is the number of ordinary thunderstones are created within the radius of the blast. These thunderstones glow for 1 minute and are easily discernible, but after this time they must be identified with a DC 15 Craft (alchemy) check.

Control Weather (Sp)

Shango may thump his Bata drum as a full-round action to cast control weather, with the changes to the weather taking effect at the end of his next turn. He can use this ability three times per day.

Mistsight (Ex)

Shango’s senses are never impaired by fog, mist, smoke, gas, or weather effects.

Split the Blades (Ex)

Shango can separate his double-bladed oxê to wield one oxê in each hand; when he does so he produces a small burst of thunder and lightning. All creatures adjacent to him take 1d8 points of electricity damage and 1d8 points of sonic damage (no save). Shango can rejoin the blades as a free action, but doing so does not create this burst of energy.

Thundering Stone (Su)

Once every 1d4 rounds, Shango can throw a rock charged with the power of the storm. When it strikes, all creatures in a 20-foot-radius burst take 12d8 points of electricity damage and 12d8 points of sonic damage (DC 33 Fortitude half). Creatures failing their save by 5 or more are hurled 1d4 x 10 feet away from the center of the blast. If they strike a solid barrier or object of their size or larger, they stop moving, fall prone, and take damage as if they had fallen the distance they moved. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Thunderous Leap (Ex)

When Shango jumps, he can jump over creatures in his path and his movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Creatures adjacent to him when he jumps take 2d8 points of electricity damage and those adjacent to where he lands take 2d8 points of sonic damage (no save).

Thunderous Strike (Ex)

A creature struck by Shango’s doublebladed oxê is stunned for 1 round (DC 33 Fort negates). A creature struck and failing multiple saves extends the duration by 1 round for each failed save. This ability does not function while his oxê is split. The save DC is Constitution-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure standard

Shango (or ?àngó) is among the mightiest of the orisha that serve the sun-lord Olórun, a child of the heavenly king and queen Obàtálá and Yemoja-Oboto. He is considered a hero who stands between mortals and the monsters of the world, called upon in times of grave danger. Though he may leave destruction in his wake, his courage and power are a bulwark of protection for those who trust in the orisha. He also is the patron of justice, dance, and virility. ?àngó primarily has dominion over thunder, fire, and lightning and combines them into thunderstones which he casts down to the ground against his foes and anyone who offends him. He can also exhale fire and smoke through his nostrils. Though feared for his tyranny and destructive powers, ?àngó received praise from worshippers for his bravery and fairness. ?àngó has three wives: Oshun, Oba, and Oya.

?àngó always wears red, and his worshipper don red clothing when conducting ceremonies venerating him.

He carries a double-bladed axe known as an oxê, which he imbues with lightning and thunder. He can detach the blades so he can more effectively fight multiple foes. Finally, he carries a Bata drum and uses it to whip up sudden storms.
